title: Movies and series
shortDescription: Chat casually about what you've been watching and recommend shows.
communicativeGoals: Describe a show or movie's plot briefly
Recommend something based on shared interests
grammarTargets: Present perfect for recent viewing ('I've just finished...')
conversationMoves: Ask what the learner has been watching
Recommend something based on what they say
Keep it conversational and opinionated, not a lecture
warmUpPrompts: What's the last thing you watched?
Do you prefer movies or series?
rolePlayPrompts: Recommend a show to me and convince me to watch it.
Disagree with my opinion about a movie and explain why.
challengePrompts: Summarize a plot without giving away spoilers.
Debate whether the book or the movie adaptation is better.
successCriteria: Learner gives an opinion, not just a description
Learner justifies their opinion with a reason
Learner asks at least one follow-up question about my taste

suggestedReviewItems.content: 'In my opinion...' for introducing a viewpoint
Present perfect for recent viewing habits

focusPlaceholder: e.g. a genre you'd like to discuss
